description:
When a New Zealand GST return and payment is due.

    Use for: 'gst due dates 2026', 'when is gst due', 'gst due date nz',
    'gst return due january', 'gst due 28th', 'six monthly gst due dates',
    'do I need to register for gst'.

    THE RULE: the 28th of the month after the taxable period ends, and payment
    is due the same day. TWO EXCEPTIONS: the period ending 30 November is due
    15 January, and the period ending 31 March is due 7 May. A due date on a
    weekend or national public holiday moves to the next working day.

    Give period_end (the period's last day) for one period, or a filing frequency
    and cycle_end_month for the next periods. Give annual_turnover to check the
    $60,000 registration threshold and the frequency limits ($500,000 for
    six-monthly, $24 million above which monthly is compulsory).

    Args:
        filing_frequency: monthly, two_monthly or six_monthly.
        period_end: A period's last day, YYYY-MM-DD.
        cycle_end_month: Any month (1 to 12) in which one of your periods ends.
        as_at: Date to list the next periods from. Omitted, today.
        count: How many upcoming periods to list, 1 to 12.
        annual_turnover: Optional 12-month turnover.

    Returns:
        Each period's dates and due date, and the turnover checks if asked.
name: nz_gst_due_dates_calculator
